# Old Minions

## Patches:

[](https://github.com/TheKillerey/Old-Summoners-Rift-V2#loads-for-riots-patch-1424---china-should-also-work-including-practice-tool)

Please check your csmanager if there are some other issues. If you have ingame crashes report it on my Discord.

## Features:

[](https://github.com/TheKillerey/Old-Summoners-Rift-V2#features)

* **Classic Minions**: Experience the Old Minions with all its classic textures, including fully working skins, old particles and team support.
* **Day**: This mod includes day version to fit the other maps versions of Old Rift. Now seperated since people don't read the description often.

## Compatibility:

[](https://github.com/TheKillerey/Old-Summoners-Rift-V2#compatibility)

* Works with the latest version of League of Legends 25.S1.2+
* Tested on various system configurations.

## Known Issues:

[](https://github.com/TheKillerey/Old-Summoners-Rift-V2#known-issues)

* No issues found!
